BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[117.81] OWNER'S RIGHT TO RESTRICT ACCESS TO EASEMENT. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to civil law; authorizing an owner to restrict access to an easement held by a government entity; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 117.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[117.81] OWNER'S RIGHT TO RESTRICT ACCESS TO EASEMENT.

Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, if an owner suffers harm related to an easement held by a local, state, or other government entity, the local, state, or other government entity must permit the owner of the property subject to the easement to restrict access to the easement, including erecting a gate or fence, to protect their property or life. If the owner erects a gate or fence or restricts access by another means, the owner must provide the local, state, or government entity with the ability to access the easement in a reasonable manner, including by providing a key or code to unlock a gate. A local, state, or government entity that fails to permit an owner to protect their property or life pursuant to this section forfeits any rights to the easement.
